title: ICI Outstanding Thesis Award - MGIT

## ICI Outstanding Thesis Award

News Date : 22 Dec 2023News ReportWe are delighted to announce that our M.Tech, Computer Aided structural Engineering student 2021-2023 batch of Civil Engineering Department, Boda Sanghavi, bearing Roll no 21261D2011 has been honoured by the Indian Concrete Institute, Hyderabad centre with the OUTSTANDING THESIS (MASTERS) award on 22nd December 2023, during the ICI Awards 2023 held at IAS officers club, Begumpet, Hyderabad, for her remarkable contribution to the field of concrete construction.Honoured by:Indian Concrete InstituteLocation:IAS officers club, Begumpet, Hyderabad
